summary: Nightly inventory backups are configured for 02:15. Node1 pulls /srv/inventory/data from node2 into dated archives under /var/backups/inventory and removes archives older than seven days. Both nodes passed restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Created the previously absent /srv/inventory/data directory on node2.
Configured restricted key-based archive streaming from node2 to node1.
Installed an atomic, locked, integrity-checking backup script on node1.
Installed and enabled the nightly cron schedule.
Demonstrated removal of an eight-day-old test archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery after changed boot identities.
Preserved AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6; installed no new packages.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Cron runs daily at 02:15; successful pulls created a valid dated archive under /var/backups/inventory, including after both restarts.
An eight-day-old test archive was deleted, and the installed cleanup rule removes dated archives with -mtime +6.
The dedicated key is restricted to the archive-streaming helper; strict host-key verification, gzip integrity, and tar listing succeeded.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 and used existing bash, tar, OpenSSH, gzip, and cronie software.
Healthy baseline boot ID e65e6bcf… changed to acfba7ae…; SSH, cron, schedule, archive data, and a fresh backup recovered.
